communication_goal: 了解背景、目标和整体流程。
image_prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE standalone educational scene illustration, square 1024x1024. Pure SOLID BLACK background, bright clean WHITE line art. Minimalist adult stick figures with circular heads, simple expressive faces, thin limbs, polished programmer workplace comic aesthetic. No colors, gradients, shading or photographic rendering. Single coherent scene, no panels. People and props central, approximately x=180..820 and y=220..790 on 0..1000 canvas. Generous blank space at top y<180, bottom y>850 and sides for later learning labels. Learning props recognizable and fully visible. Conversation gestures. NO speech bubbles, letters, numbers, captions, logos, watermark, readable code or writing. Simple abstract UI symbols allowed. Scene: Two adult stick-figure coworkers stand beside a large freestanding whiteboard on the RIGHT. The board contains one clear three-box flow diagram connected by arrows, with no writing. Coworker on left listens with open palm; coworker at center points to the diagram without covering it. The whole board and entire diagram are unobstructed.

coverage_review.scope: W005 的逐词编辑与底图视觉核对完成；本专题其他计划卡未制作，不声称学习效果或手机端验收。

annotation_coordinate_system: [x_min, y_min, x_max, y_max]，左上角为原点，按最终 images/W005.png 宽高归一化至 0..1；由人工视觉定位。

image_review.summary: 通过：纯黑背景白色火柴人线稿，单幅双人工作沟通场景、底图无文字；白板上的完整框箭头图可以定位；流程含义由对白设定。 其余3词仅以明确对白支持，不虚构局部框。 局部裁剪复查后扩大右/下边界，保护完整道具。
